name: Slideshow
description: A simple presentation maker and presenter for a space. Editors build a deck of slides — stylized text (headings, body, bullet lists), uploaded images and shapes — laid out freely on a fixed slide canvas; everything is positioned and sized proportionally, so the deck looks the same from a small tile to a fullscreen presentation. Viewers and anonymous link visitors can browse and present the deck but not edit it, and editors see how many are watching. The deck follows the space's channel colour; a few show-wide settings (background, slide aspect, and an optional "keep viewers in sync" mode that keeps every viewer on the presenter's slide) sit beside the slides. The deck is one file of the space, Slideshow/slides.json, with its uploaded images (resized, 8 MB at most) in Slideshow/images, synced with the space and served by the frame to everyone who sees the deck.
